summary: Ryan Duke contacted HomeNet support because some websites were not loading while others did. The agent identified a DNS issue and switched his connection to updated servers which resolved the problem for both sites. He then guided Ryan through testing one of the failing sites again, confirming its functionality. Finally, he thanked him for the quick resolution.
